standard_prerequisites.name: An object of finite tor amplitude over the base is R-perfect as soon as it is pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the implication from (2) to (1) to showing that a flat finitely presented module is pseudo-coherent.

standard_prerequisites.name: A flat finitely presented module over a base descends to a finitely generated situation, where finite type modules over Noetherian rings are pseudo-coherent
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the finitely generated model M_0 over a finitely generated base and its pseudo-coherence, and the finite free resolution that spreads out.

standard_prerequisites.name: A bounded above complex of finite free modules whose truncation cuts at the tor amplitude lower bound consists of flat finitely presented modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the representing complex for the implication from (1) to (2).

core_obligations: Reduce (2) implies (1) to the single case of an R-flat finitely presented module M: finite tor dimension over R is clear and only pseudo-coherence of M is left (proof lines 21990-21995).
Spread M out to a finitely generated base: find R_0 and a flat finite type map R_0 to A_0 with a finite A_0-module M_0 flat over R_0 whose base change is M (proof lines 21995-22002).

Use that a finite module over a Noetherian ring is pseudo-coherent to get M_0 pseudo-coherent, then resolve M_0 by finite free A_0-modules and base change that finite free resolution, keeping it exact because A_0 is flat over R_0 (proof lines 22003-22013).
Conclude that M has a finite free resolution over A, hence is pseudo-coherent, and apply the finite tor dimension reduction to get (1) (proof lines 22010-22014).

For (1) implies (2), represent K by a bounded above complex of finite free modules and cut it at the lower end of the tor amplitude over R, which produces a complex of flat finitely presented modules representing K (proof lines 22015-22019).
proof_roadmap: (2) implies (1): reduce to a flat finitely presented module (proof lines 21990-21995).
Descend to a finitely generated model and resolve it by finite free modules (proof lines 21995-22010).
Base change the resolution and conclude pseudo-coherence of M, hence R-perfectness (proof lines 22010-22014).
(1) implies (2): truncate a finite free resolution below the tor amplitude bound (proof lines 22015-22019).
difficulty_reason: statement 是 R-perfect 的结构刻画（等价于有限个 R-平坦有限表现模的复形）。证明两向都不长但都很实：正向先把问题归结到一个 R-平坦有限表现模的伪凝聚性，用「平坦有限表现下降到一个有限生成的模型」把 M 写成 M_0 的基变换，再拿 Noetherian 情形下有限模的伪凝聚性、有限自由消解以及 A_0/R_0 的平坦性把消解基变换回去；反向只做一件实事——把有限自由表示在 tor amplitude 下界处截断，得到全是平坦有限表现模的复形。6 处引用里 4 处同章、2 处跨章，承重演算都在 span 内，引用作导航桩。
